title: Application for Federal Domestic Assistance-Short Organizational (SF-424)
description: SF-424 Short Organizational definition and source plan (FID711 v3.0), using shared question-bank parts and authored XSD mappings. One-to-many applicant-type mapping and exact XML-output parity remain explicit blockers.
notes: One ordered list represents the three applicant-type slots in the DAT and XSD. The existing API spelling of applicant type H is preserved, with its per-item XML normalization tracked as a gap.
The form uses the shared Person question twice. Title and email are required for each role. The director, contact and authorized representative remain distinct.
The Same as Project Director checkbox follows current SGG wording and still requires both roles. DAT 8-02 says to skip to item 9; contact copy and omission need review.

The opportunity and UEI use the existing six pre-population providers. Received date, signature and signing date use existing submission providers. The two authored examples are fictional drafts and omit the signing outputs.
The certification text matches the DAT wording. Existing SGG uses lightly edited copy; source review remains open.

DAT0-0 burden statement: Clicking displays burden statement:
SF-424 SHORT ORGANIZATIONAL FORM (4040-0003)

According to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, an agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to a collection of information unless it displays a valid OMB control number. The valid OMB control number for this information collection is 4040-0003. The time required to complete this information collection is estimated to average 24 minutes per response, including the time to review instructions, search existing data resources, gather the data needed and complete and review the information collection. If you have comments concerning the accuracy of the time estimate(s) or suggestions for improving this form, please write to: U.S. Department of Health & Human Services, OS/OCIO/PRA, 200 Independence Ave., S.W., Suite 537-H, Washington D.C. 20201, Attention: PRA Reports Clearance Officer.

Total                 14600                                                                         5893

5893 total hrs. x 60 minutes = 353,580 total minutes.
353,580 / 14600 total responses = 24 minutes per response.
risks: Named applicant-type slots, per-item H-label normalization and empty DateReceived wire behavior need integration qualification.
The DAT allows 50 characters for the web address and specifies a nine-digit US ZIP. The draft preserves the current web-address limit of 250 and the common address rule.
Source decisions on affirmative certification, the contact skip, empty Other explanations and applicant-type duplicates remain for review.
